name: The Good News According to Matthew

verses.text: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.
Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.
He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “\+w Behold \+w a farmer \+w went \+w out \+w to \+w sow *
\+w As \+w he \+w sowed \+w some seeds \+w fell \+w by \+w the roadside, \+w and \+w the \+w birds \+w came \+w and \+w devoured \+w them *

\+w Others \+w fell \+w on \+w rocky \+w ground \+w where \+w they didn’\+w t \+w have \+w much \+w soil \+w and \+w immediately \+w they \+w sprang \+w up \+w because \+w they \+w had \+w no depth \+w of \+w earth *
\+w When \+w the \+w sun \+w had \+w risen \+w they \+w were \+w scorched \+w Because \+w they \+w had \+w no \+w root \+w they \+w withered \+w away *
\+w Others \+w fell \+w among thorns. \+w The thorns grew \+w up \+w and \+w choked \+w them *
\+w Others \+w fell \+w on \+w good \+w soil \+w and \+w yielded \+w fruit \+w some \+w one \+w hundred times \+w as much, \+w some \+w sixty \+w and \+w some \+w thirty *
\+w He \+w who \+w has \+w ears \+w to hear, \+w let \+w him hear.”*
The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”
He answered them, “\+w To \+w you \+w it \+w is \+w given \+w to \+w know \+w the \+w mysteries \+w of \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w but \+w it \+w is \+w not \+w given \+w to \+w them *

\+w For \+w whoever \+w has \+w to \+w him \+w will \+w be \+w given \+w and \+w he \+w will \+w have \+w abundance \+w but \+w whoever doesn’t \+w have \+w from \+w him \+w will \+w be taken away \+w even \+w that \+w which \+w he \+w has *
\+w Therefore \+w I \+w speak \+w to \+w them \+w in \+w parables \+w because \+w seeing \+w they don’t see, \+w and hearing, \+w they don’t hear, \+w neither \+w do \+w they \+w understand *

\+w In \+w them \+w the \+w prophecy \+w of \+w Isaiah \+w is fulfilled, \+w which \+w says * ‘\+w By hearing \+w you \+w will hear,* \+w and \+w will \+w in \+w no way \+w understand \+w Seeing \+w you \+w will \+w see \+w and \+w will \+w in \+w no way \+w perceive

\+w for \+w this \+w people \+w heart \+w has grown callous,* \+w their \+w ears \+w are \+w dull \+w of \+w hearing \+w and \+w they \+w have \+w closed \+w their \+w eyes \+w or \+w else \+w perhaps \+w they \+w might \+w perceive \+w with \+w their \+w eyes hear \+w with \+w their \+w ears \+w understand \+w with \+w their \+w heart \+w and \+w would \+w turn \+w again \+w and \+w I \+w would \+w heal \+w them
“\+w But \+w blessed \+w are \+w your \+w eyes \+w for \+w they see; \+w and \+w your \+w ears \+w for \+w they hear. *

\+w For \+w most \+w certainly \+w I \+w tell \+w you \+w that \+w many \+w prophets \+w and \+w righteous \+w men \+w desired \+w to \+w see \+w the \+w things \+w which \+w you \+w see \+w and didn’t \+w see \+w them \+w and \+w to hear \+w the \+w things \+w which \+w you hear, \+w and didn’t hear \+w them
“Hear, \+w then \+w the \+w parable \+w of \+w the farmer. *

\+w When \+w anyone hears \+w the \+w word \+w of \+w the Kingdom \+w and doesn’\+w t \+w understand \+w it \+w the \+w evil \+w one \+w comes \+w and snatches away \+w that \+w which \+w has \+w been \+w sown \+w in \+w his \+w heart \+w This \+w is \+w what \+w was \+w sown \+w by \+w the roadside. *
\+w What \+w was \+w sown \+w on \+w the \+w rocky places, \+w this \+w is \+w he \+w who hears \+w the \+w word \+w and \+w immediately \+w with \+w joy \+w receives \+w it *

\+w yet \+w he \+w has \+w no \+w root \+w in \+w himself \+w but endures \+w for \+w a \+w while \+w When oppression \+w or \+w persecution \+w arises \+w because \+w of \+w the \+w word \+w immediately \+w he stumbles. *

\+w What \+w was \+w sown \+w among \+w the thorns, \+w this \+w is \+w he \+w who hears \+w the \+w word \+w but \+w the \+w cares \+w of \+w this age \+w and \+w the deceitfulness \+w of \+w riches \+w choke \+w the \+w word \+w and \+w he \+w becomes unfruitful. *

\+w What \+w was \+w sown \+w on \+w the \+w good \+w ground \+w this \+w is \+w he \+w who hears \+w the \+w word \+w and \+w understands \+w it \+w who most \+w certainly \+w bears \+w fruit \+w and \+w produces \+w some \+w one \+w hundred times \+w as much, \+w some \+w sixty \+w and \+w some \+w thirty
He set another parable before them, saying, “\+w The Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w like \+w a man \+w who \+w sowed \+w good \+w seed \+w in \+w his field, *
\+w but \+w while \+w people \+w slept \+w his \+w enemy \+w came \+w and \+w sowed darnel \+w weeds \+w also \+w among \+w the \+w wheat \+w and \+w went away. *
\+w But \+w when \+w the \+w blade sprang \+w up \+w and \+w produced \+w grain \+w then \+w the darnel \+w weeds \+w appeared \+w also *

\+w The \+w servants \+w of \+w the \+w householder \+w came \+w and \+w said \+w to \+w him ‘\+w Sir didn’\+w t \+w you \+w sow \+w good \+w seed \+w in \+w your field? \+w Where \+w did \+w these darnel \+w weeds \+w come \+w from
“\+w He \+w said \+w to \+w them ‘\+w An \+w enemy \+w has \+w done \+w this “\+w The \+w servants \+w asked \+w him ‘\+w Do \+w you \+w want \+w us \+w to \+w go \+w and \+w gather \+w them \+w up *
“\+w But \+w he \+w said ‘\+w No \+w lest \+w perhaps \+w while you \+w gather \+w up \+w the darnel \+w weeds you root \+w up \+w the \+w wheat \+w with \+w them *

\+w Let \+w both \+w grow \+w together \+w until \+w the \+w harvest \+w and \+w in \+w the \+w harvest \+w time \+w I \+w will \+w tell \+w the \+w reapers “\+w First \+w gather \+w up \+w the darnel \+w weeds \+w and \+w bind \+w them \+w in \+w bundles \+w to \+w burn \+w them \+w but \+w gather \+w the \+w wheat \+w into \+w my barn.”’”*

He set another parable before them, saying, “\+w The Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w like \+w a \+w grain \+w of \+w mustard \+w seed \+w which \+w a \+w man \+w took \+w and \+w sowed \+w in \+w his field, *

\+w which \+w indeed \+w is \+w smaller \+w than \+w all \+w seeds \+w But \+w when \+w it \+w is \+w grown \+w it \+w is \+w greater \+w than \+w the \+w herbs \+w and \+w becomes \+w a \+w tree \+w so \+w that \+w the \+w birds \+w of \+w the \+w air \+w come \+w and \+w lodge \+w in \+w its \+w branches

He spoke another parable to them. “\+w The Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w like \+w yeast \+w which \+w a \+w woman \+w took \+w and \+w hid \+w in \+w three \+w measures \+w of meal, \+w until \+w it \+w was \+w all \+w leavened
Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”
Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”
He answered them, “\+w He \+w who \+w sows \+w the \+w good \+w seed \+w is \+w the \+w Son \+w of \+w Man *

\+w the field \+w is \+w the \+w world \+w the \+w good \+w seeds \+w are \+w the \+w children \+w of \+w the Kingdom, \+w and \+w the darnel \+w weeds \+w are \+w the \+w children \+w of \+w the \+w evil \+w one *
\+w The \+w enemy \+w who \+w sowed \+w them \+w is \+w the \+w devil \+w The \+w harvest \+w is \+w the \+w end \+w of \+w the age, \+w and \+w the \+w reapers \+w are angels. *
\+w As \+w therefore \+w the darnel \+w weeds \+w are \+w gathered \+w up \+w and \+w burned \+w with \+w fire \+w so \+w will \+w it \+w be \+w at \+w the \+w end \+w of \+w this age. *

\+w The \+w Son \+w of \+w Man \+w will send \+w out \+w his angels, \+w and \+w they \+w will \+w gather \+w out \+w of \+w his Kingdom \+w all \+w things \+w that \+w cause \+w stumbling \+w and \+w those \+w who \+w do iniquity, *
\+w and \+w will \+w cast \+w them \+w into \+w the \+w furnace \+w of \+w fire \+w There \+w will \+w be \+w weeping \+w and \+w gnashing \+w of \+w teeth *
\+w Then \+w the \+w righteous \+w will \+w shine \+w like \+w the \+w sun \+w in \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w their \+w Father \+w He \+w who \+w has \+w ears \+w to hear, \+w let \+w him hear.*

“\+w Again \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w like \+w treasure \+w hidden \+w in \+w the field, \+w which \+w a \+w man \+w found \+w and \+w hid \+w In \+w his \+w joy \+w he \+w goes \+w and \+w sells \+w all \+w that \+w he \+w has \+w and buys \+w that field.*
“\+w Again \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w like \+w a man \+w who \+w is \+w a \+w merchant \+w seeking \+w fine \+w pearls *
\+w who \+w having \+w found \+w one \+w pearl \+w of \+w great price, \+w he \+w went \+w and \+w sold \+w all \+w that \+w he \+w had \+w and bought \+w it
“\+w Again \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w like \+w a \+w dragnet \+w that \+w was \+w cast \+w into \+w the \+w sea \+w and \+w gathered \+w some fish \+w of \+w every \+w kind *

\+w which \+w when \+w it \+w was \+w filled fishermen \+w drew \+w up \+w on \+w the beach. \+w They \+w sat \+w down \+w and \+w gathered \+w the \+w good \+w into containers, \+w but \+w the \+w bad \+w they threw \+w away *
\+w So \+w it \+w will \+w be \+w in \+w the \+w end \+w of \+w the world.* \+w The angels \+w will \+w come \+w and separate \+w the \+w wicked \+w from \+w among \+w the \+w righteous *
\+w and \+w will \+w cast \+w them \+w into \+w the \+w furnace \+w of \+w fire \+w There \+w will \+w be \+w weeping \+w and \+w gnashing \+w of \+w teeth
Jesus said to them, “\+w Have \+w you \+w understood \+w all \+w these \+w things * They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

He said to them, “\+w Therefore \+w every \+w scribe \+w who \+w has \+w been \+w made \+w a \+w disciple \+w in \+w the Kingdom \+w of \+w Heaven \+w is \+w like \+w a \+w man \+w who \+w is \+w a \+w householder \+w who \+w brings \+w out \+w of \+w his \+w treasure \+w new \+w and \+w old \+w things
When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.
Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?
Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?
Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “\+w A \+w prophet \+w is \+w not \+w without honor, \+w except \+w in \+w his \+w own \+w country \+w and \+w in \+w his \+w own \+w house
He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
